background.title: Background
background.historyTitle: History of Establishment of the Cambodian Police Training Schools
background.introduction: After the official creation of the Cambodian National Police Force in 1945, the Training School for National Police was established and subsequently changed names throughout different historical periods.
background.period2Description: The Personnel Education and Training Center was established in 1973.
background.period3: III. People's Republic of Kampuchea / State of Cambodia (1979–1993)
background.period3Description: The People's Police Institution was led by Comrade Chhea Sim. The Central People's Police School was established in 1979 and located in BoreyKeyLar.
background.branch1: People's Police School 1 — KorbSrov area, Phnom Penh
background.branch4: People's Police School 4 — Prey Veng Province
background.toulKorkDescription: The Toul Kork National Police School was established in 1991 in Toul Kork, Phnom Penh.
background.deyEthDescription: Established in Sdao Kanleng village, Kien Svay district, Kandal province.
background.royalSchoolDescription: The Royal Police School was transformed from the DeyEth National Police School in 2002.
background.academyDescription: The Police Academy of Cambodia (PAC) was transformed from the Royal Police School in 2007.
background.currentLocation: The academy is currently located in Sdao Kanleng village, DeyEth commune, Kien Svay district, Kandal province. Its land area covers 134,922 square meters, or more than 13 hectares.
background.aboutDescription: Learn more about the Police Academy of Cambodia and its educational activities.

roles.title: Roles and Responsibilities
roles.introduction: The Police Academy of Cambodia is a public educational institution with a status equivalent to a General Department. It serves as an advisory body to the Minister of Interior on police science research in the fields of security, public order, and the training of national police personnel and prison officials throughout the country.
roles.responsibility1Description: Conduct research in police science, security, and public order to support the work of the Ministry of Interior.
roles.responsibility2Description: Provide training and professional development for national police personnel and prison officials throughout Cambodia.
roles.responsibility3Description: The Police Academy of Cambodia has 10 subordinate units at department-equivalent level and one department.
roles.responsibility4Description: The Academy has the authority to report directly to and consult with the Minister of Interior.
roles.regionalSchoolsDescription: The Academy has seven police training schools across the provinces, including the Cambodia–Vietnam Friendship National Police School.
roles.province1: Regional Police School 1 — Stung Treng Province
roles.province2: Regional Police School 2 — Kampong Cham Province
roles.province3: Regional Police School 3 — Kampong Speu Province
roles.province4: Regional Police School 4 — Siem Reap Province
roles.commitmentDescription: The Academy's training network also includes Regional Police School 6 in Kampong Chhnang Province and the Cambodia–Vietnam Friendship National Police School in Kampong Speu Province.
roles.aboutDescription: Learn about the Police Academy of Cambodia, its history, responsibilities, and professional training mission.

strategic.title: Strategic
strategic.introduction: To achieve the established vision, objectives, and goals, the Police Academy of Cambodia has outlined the following strategies:
strategic.strategy1: Strengthening leadership and management capabilities in line with good government principles.
strategic.strategy2: Enhancing the efficiency of financial management.
strategic.strategy3: Strengthening and expanding national and international cooperation.
strategic.strategy6: Developing the capacity of professors and national police instructors, and selecting successor national police instructors.
strategic.strategy8: Strengthening mechanisms to ensure educational quality.
strategic.strategy10: Developing the capacity of officers and enhancing the efficiency of research.
strategic.strategy11: Promoting and expanding the scope of police science research.
strategic.conclusion: These strategies guide the Police Academy of Cambodia in developing its educational programs, strengthening institutional capacity, and advancing police science research.
strategic.aboutDescription: The Police Academy of Cambodia provides education and training and supports the development of professional police personnel.
